definitions.gloss: photo book; photography collection; photo album (published)
definitions.explanation: A published book consisting primarily of photographs, whether art photography, landscape photography, celebrity portraits, or documentary photography.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{写真集|しゃしんしゅう}が{出|で}た。
examples.english: A new photo book came out.

examples.japanese: {風景|ふうけい}{写真集|しゃしんしゅう}を{眺|なが}めるのが{好|す}きだ。
examples.english: I like looking through landscape photography books.

examples.japanese: あのアイドルの{写真集|しゃしんしゅう}は{発売|はつばい}{初日|しょにち}に{売|う}り{切|き}れた。
examples.english: That idol's photo book sold out on its first day of release.

notes:
Composed of {写真|しゃしん} (photograph) + {集|しゅう} (collection). In Japan, celebrity {写真集|しゃしんしゅう} are a major publishing genre — idols, actors, and athletes regularly release photo books. The suffix {集|しゅう} is productive and appears in many compound nouns ({詩集|ししゅう}, {短編集|たんぺんしゅう}, etc.).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {写真集|しゃしんしゅう}を{出|だ}す: to publish a photo book
- {風景|ふうけい}{写真集|しゃしんしゅう}: landscape photography book
- {写真集|しゃしんしゅう}が{売|う}れる: a photo book sells well

RELATED WORDS:
- フォトブック: photo book (loanword, often for personal/custom books)
- アルバム: album — broader, includes personal photo albums
- {画集|がしゅう}: art book; collection of paintings
